method: Read unchanged original stereo PCM. 2048-sample Hann STFT/256-sample hop; band RMS log-envelope positive derivative,5-point smoothing, prominence threshold. Frequency bands support rhythmic-body vs bright attack classification but do not separate sources. Existing fitted pulse phase is an editorial candidate.

pulsePlan.bpmStatus: fit to recurring strong spectral-flux accents; metrical phase remains editorial

fashion.limitations: Frequency-band attacks are source measurements, not separated drums, confirmed beats/bar phase, vocals/lyrics or completed listening review.
